ram.subject: Notice: Tomorrow's Re-examination
ram.body:
Dear Satvik,

I hope this message finds you well.

This is an important notice regarding the re-examination scheduled to be conducted tomorrow. Please note that attendance is mandatory; if you miss this, there is no other chance, and there will be no further opportunity to appear.

Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Best regards,

Best regards,
